primitives.name: Persistent Virtual Machine State
primitives.verbatim_quote: Compute & runtime (Motif's VM) - **Linux VM, persistent home** (`~` survives restarts; `/tmp` does not).
primitives.assumptions: VM state persists across restarts via persistent home directory; temporary files are ephemeral.
primitives.breakdown_regime: State loss occurs when `~` is corrupted or deleted.

layer2.mapping: VM state isomorphic to a Markov chain over time-indexed filesystem snapshots.

primitives.name: Agent Bus Communication Protocol
primitives.verbatim_quote: — task packages addressed TO an agent - `outbox/from-motif/`, `outbox/from-opencode/`, ...
primitives.assumptions: Communication is mediated through structured directories and task packages.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure when outbox/inbox paths are inaccessible or malformed.

layer2.mapping: Agent bus kernel derived from Git-based version control and filesystem-based message queues.
layer2.telemetry: Task delivery success rate, queue depth metrics

primitives.name: Credential-Secure Data Flow
primitives.verbatim_quote: Nothing here is a raw secret — see §8 for the credential rule.
primitives.assumptions: No raw secrets stored; all access uses secure platform APIs.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Risk increases with unauthorized access to credential store.

layer2.mapping: Secure credential flow isomorphic to a zero-knowledge authentication protocol.
layer2.telemetry: Access log integrity, credential rotation frequency
